recipe.visualDefinition: A profile portrait of a mature man with a full grey beard and cowboy hat, set against a cluttered, rustic barn background featuring ropes and leather tack. The lighting is dramatic and directional, creating high contrast and a warm, earthy atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile gaze vs. background texture
Warm skin tones vs. cool shadows in the barn
Ornate, circular logo vs. rugged, linear background elements
Soft beard texture vs. hard leather and rope materials
coreInvariants: Full, well-groomed grey beard and mustache
Earthy palette of browns, tans, and muted blues
Low-key lighting with a strong key light from the side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame in a medium close-up profile view.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and beard, highlighted by the primary light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's profile, follows his gaze to the left, then circles back through the background ropes to the logo in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with textures and objects to suggest a lived-in environment.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans (leather, wood, clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep shadows and dark background recesses
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White/cream for the beard and the graphic logo
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; colors are muted to emphasize texture and mood.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid bright primary reds or yellows

letterConstructionRules: Circular enclosure for the top text
Extreme swashes that interlock and form decorative flourishes
Variable stroke width with thick stems and thin hairlines
Integrated underline that doubles as a decorative border
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended tails on 'y' and 's' to wrap around other letters
Interlocking 'G' and 'N' in the secondary text block

typesetting.case: Mixed case for name, All-caps for title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single complex decorative mark against a photographic background.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, low-key profile photo of a man with a grey beard and cowboy hat in a rustic barn filled with ropes and leather. Use warm, directional lighting and a muted earth-tone palette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a circular, white, ornate swash-heavy logo in the upper right corner. The logo should feature interlocking decorative lettering and scrollwork.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting directional and high-contrast?
Does the beard have a distinct white/grey texture?
Is the logo placed in the upper right without obscuring the face?
Are the background elements (ropes, tack) visible but secondary?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact text content of the logo
Specific brand logos on the background equipment
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the hat brim creates a shadow over the eyes.
Check that the beard texture looks natural and not airbrushed.
Verify the logo has a hand-drawn, calligraphic quality.
Confirm the color palette remains within earthy, desaturated tones.
recipe.reuseFormula: Rustic Portrait + Directional Side Light + Decorative Swash Logo Overlay
